common.privacyNotice: B+ coordinates introductions. A medical facility must confirm donation eligibility.
common.translationReview: Safety and privacy translations require human review before production.

home.title: Find willing donors without exposing private information.
home.description: B+ helps people and verified organizations coordinate blood donation requests. Matching is not consent: contact and precise destination details stay protected until a donor explicitly accepts.
home.limitedText: Potential donors see only blood type, urgency, facility area, and approximate distance.
home.consentText: A donor actively accepts before protected coordination details become available.
home.connectText: An accepted match creates a private, expiring conversation.
home.boundaryTitle: A coordination platform, not medical advice
home.boundaryText: Hospitals and qualified professionals determine compatibility, donor eligibility, screening, and collection.

public.aboutText: B+ is a privacy-first coordination platform for people, donors, and approved blood-donation organizations in Myanmar.
public.howText: A request is verified, suitable donors receive limited information, and private coordination starts only after explicit acceptance.
public.safetyText: Do not use B+ for diagnosis or emergency medical advice. Contact the relevant hospital or emergency service. Never share unnecessary patient details.
